saved mask comes from C13. It reads /work/data.npz, written in C10 with the full 60x60 region and complete daily coverage. Per-cell thresholds come from ±5-day baseline pools (hazen 90th percentile), smoothed with a wrapping 31-day mean; the dummy expression at L13 is never evaluated because of `if False`, and L15 overwrites it. The target days 2013-06-01 to 2013-08-31 (day of year 153–244) need smoothed days 153–244, hence raw days 138–259, so only 12 May–20 Sep of each baseline year reaches the mask. Every sea cell is compared with its own threshold, and runs are found over all 92 target days."}
